stories.title: Wemby makes history in 18 minutes, finishes game with 50 points
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama had his third career 50-point outing in Sunday's win vs. the Pelicans, to go along with 19 rebounds, five blocks and four steals.

stories.title: Indiana's CFP, Big Ten title hopes in peril after OT loss at Washington
stories.summary: Indiana might not get a chance to defend its national championship after losing 27-24 at Washington on Saturday.

stories.title: Verstappen wins dramatic Las Vegas GP; Ferraris clash
stories.summary: Max Verstappen delivered a performance for the ages to win a thrill-a-minute Las Vegas Grand Prix -- as Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided.

stories.title: Sources: Nacua needs 4-5 months to recover from knee surgery, out for playoffs
stories.summary: Puka Nacua's recovery time from MCL surgery is considered to be four to five months, sources told ESPN, meaning he will miss the playoffs.

stories.title: No. 1 Georgia clinches 6th straight SEC title game berth with win at No. 21 South Carolina
stories.summary: Nate Frazier ran for 94 yards and two touchdowns, and No. 1 Georgia clinched a spot in the final SEC championship game with a victory over South Carolina on Saturday night.
